'''Distol''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]], the [[Saurton]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. It was located in the north-western hemisphere, on the continent of [[Sorontill]].
